coordinateConventions.alphaBounds: [x, y, width, height] of pixels with alpha > 32; right and bottom are exclusive
coordinateConventions.runtimeMetadataAuthority: The header is authoritative for the final control coordinate frame (frontPlane), supportY, topHandle and channelWindows. Mutable layout landmarks are deliberately not duplicated in this manifest.

renderingContract: Draw the complete source PNG with one uniform transform. Do not split, stretch, or reconstruct its roof, corners, handle, side walls, or feet. Live knobs, labels and channel state are rendered by JUCE.
evidenceBoundary: Generation instructions and source-art inspection do not establish native UI, host, interaction, or product acceptance. Native captures must identify their exact source commit and CI run.

instructionRecord.text:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production transparent RGBA amplifier head for a JUCE audio plugin.
Create a fundamental coherent full-object redraw of reference image 1, not a pasted patch or a roof extension. Reference image 1 is the identity and front construction reference (Glass); reference image 2 is ONLY the camera, integrated three-dimensional roof construction and lighting reference. Do not copy reference 2's grille, silver control plate, vertical handles or proportions.
Subject identity to preserve: Silver and charcoal tightly woven grille cloth fills upper 62% of front opening, completely plain dark charcoal control plate fills bottom 38%, fine cream piping frames opening. Pebbled black tolex enclosure, classic small silver rounded metal corner protectors, original narrow arched black strap handle with small silver mounts, two black rubber feet. Preserve this exact model's recognizable woven silver grille and unadorned charcoal panel.
Physical body envelope: 673.1 mm wide x 225 mm front body high x 263.53 mm deep; front body width to height ratio 2.99:1. Keep the original front grille/blank-control-panel division and all usable empty control-panel area. Physical dimensions inform the enclosure silhouette; do not draw dimension labels.
Camera and construction: EXACTLY centered in front, zero yaw, zero roll, near orthographic long-lens perspective, about 9 degrees above horizontal. Both sides perfectly symmetric, horizontal panel lines. A modest shallow integrated top surface recedes from the front top lip to the back edge, visibly attached to one complete box with natural continuous rounded upper corners, top handle and bottom feet. Roof visible depth should be about 12 to 17% of front body height, similar to reference 2. Roof/front/sides are a single coherent object, not separate slabs; rear edge lies low behind handle, never an upright wall. Entire front top lip and both rounded upper corners intact and uncut.
Composition: clean studio-quality photorealistic product render, landscape approximately 2048 by 1152 pixels, object centered with at least 5% clear transparent margin on all sides, complete handle and all feet visible, no cropping. Preserve natural enclosure width/height ratio; no stretching. Soft neutral upper-left studio highlights, dark readable material relief, lighting consistent with reference 2.
Background: genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the product. No floor, horizon, pedestal, reflection or cast ground shadow.
Blank control panel essential: ZERO knobs, switches, sockets, meters, LEDs, UI graphics, numerals, letters, labels, badges, branding or logos. All control hardware will be supplied live by software. Tiny structural screws and amber tube glow behind grille are allowed only where original.
Avoid: cut-away upper corners, upper-corner notches, disconnected roof wings, side volumes, double lid, extra stacked slab, backboard, raised rear fin, upright back plane, speaker cabinet, exaggerated top depth, three-quarter angle, perspective yaw, text, watermark, background.
